friction_factors.explanation: Patient lacks dedicated family member to assist with hospital navigation and registration queues.

friction_factors.explanation: Missing or unorganized physical ID/insurance cards causing registration friction.
friction_factors.suggested_intervention: Upload and verify documents in digital Document Vault before leaving home.

friction_factors.explanation: Preferred communication in local language (PA) rather than complex medical English.
friction_factors.suggested_intervention: Provide multilingual vernacular forms and audio-assisted summaries.
